game.name: Splatoon 2
game.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Playing on an emulator is banned.
- Playing on a modified game file is banned.
- Turbo controls are only allowed for mashing through textboxes.

**Timing:**

- Don't submit your time with milliseconds.

**Video:**

- Video submissions should be watchable to everyone and be uploaded to either YouTube or Google Drive as a public or unlisted video, or on bilibili.
- Your speedrun can be split up into a maximum of 5 videos.
- Video quality should not be lower than 360p (640x360, 30fps)
- A game capture device is not required, phone/tablet/camera recordings are allowed as long as the gameplay is recognizable.
- Runs with missing footage may be rejected on a case by case basis.

categories.name: OE Escape RTA
categories.rules:
- Must be done on a completed file.
- Time starts when "Remember the fight" is selected in the Central Station.
- All 7 phases of the Escape Sequence must be completed.
- Time ends when the "Agent 3 Defeated" text appears on screen.
- Using the in-game level skipping feature by dying on purpose is banned.
- All cutscenes, apart from the first blender cutscene, cannot be skipped due to this being a practice category related to Any% No Death Abuse.
- All runs better than a 18:00 must have permanent video proof present.

categories.name: OE NG+
categories.rules:
- Must be done on a completed file.
- Time starts when you enter Deep Sea Metro. (whether this is from selecting the option in the pause menu, or the subway alley entrance in the Square it doesn't matter)
- You must complete every level in the Octo Expansion Any% No Death Abuse route, (due to this being a practice category) the Escape Sequence, and beat the NILS Statue in any order. (However you aren't required to beat the Thang stages as they are inaccessible from a completed file)
- Time ends when the GAME! tape appears after all the hyperbombs explode on the NILS Statue. (when the tape appears on the side of the screen) Or when the words "Test Passed!" appears after completing the final level played in the Deep Sea Metro Subway Map.
- Using the in-game level skipping feature by dying on purpose is banned.
- Skipping cutscenes is allowed.
- All runs better than a 56:00 must have permanent video proof present.

categories.name: HM + OE Any%
categories.rules:
- This is an RTA run of both Hero Mode Any% and Octo Expansion Any% NDA
- Time begins on selecting "Yeah!" on character creation before the main tutorial.
- Time ends on the goal tape appearing after the NILS Statue fight.

categories.name: HM + OE All Missions
categories.rules:
- This is an RTA run of Splatoon 2 Hero Mode and Octo Expansion All Missions
- Time begins on selecting "Yeah!" on character creation before the main tutorial.
- Time ends when the "Agent 3 Defeated!" text appears on screen during the secret boss fight.

- Must be done on a new file.
- This is an RTA run of Splatoon 2 Hero Mode 1000% and Splatoon 2 Octo Expansion 100%.
- You may not start with OE due to the start of the run being from a partially completed file. However you are allowed to go straight to OE after getting to Inkopolis Square.
- Time starts when you select Yeah! in the Character Select screen. (for your Inkling)
- Time can end in two different ways. Touching the zapfish in the final level played for S2 HM. (when the screen around the zapfish starts to turn blurry) The "Inner Agent 3 Defeated" text appearing on screen for S2 OE.
- You may verify S2 HM 1000% and S2 OE 100% completion either during the run itself or after the run is completed.
- All runs in this category require full video proof due to collectables needing to be verified that they are collected.
- For more info and rules for runs similar to this, read the game rules on this page. (https://www.speedrun.com/multisplatoon)

categories.name: NG+
categories.rules:
- You may play on a new or completed file. (the latter is highly recommended)
- Use the In-Game Timer or the IGT at the top of the screen when submitting your run.
- When submitting your run be sure to choose which weapon you used.
- Complete and permanent video and audio proof is **REQUIRED for all world records (including tied world records)**.
- Runs which are not world records may be verified with a screenshot or switch clip.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Defeat DJ Octavio from a new file.

**Timing:**

- Time starts when when your inkling pops out of the grate after entering Octo Canyon.
- Time ends when you dunk the Rainmaker onto Octavio. (when the green circle appears)

**Video:**

- The version number must be visible and legible.
- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio.
- All runs faster than 1:39:00 must have permanent video proof present.
- Speedruns without video proof must submit their splits with a picture in the description, or with a splits.io link.

categories.name: NG+
categories.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Complete all levels on a completed file. 

**Timing:**

- Time starts when when your inkling pops out of the grate after entering Octo Canyon.
- Time ends when you touch the Zapfish in the final level played. (when the screen around the Zapfish turns blurry)

**Video:**

- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio
- All runs faster than 1:13:00 must have permanent video proof present.
- Speedruns without video proof must submit their splits with a picture in the description, or with a splits.io link.

Note: If you would like to do a run of this category without Octavio, (or have an Octavioless time alongside this run) submit your run to the ‘NG+ Octavioless’ category located in the miscellaneous section: https://speedrun.com/Splatoon2?&x=jdrn9lxk

categories.name: All Collectables
categories.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Collect all Scrolls and Sardinium on a new file.

**Timing:**

- Time starts when when your inkling pops out of the grate after entering Octo Canyon.
- Time ends when you dunk the Rainmaker onto Octavio. (when the green circle appears)

**Video:**

- The version number must be visible and legible.
- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio.
- All runs in this category require full video proof.
- After defeating Octavio you must advance to the credits and watch them in its entirety. (This is due to the Sardinium for Octavio not counting as collected until the credits are over. This also means you are not allowed to skip the credits by quitting and re-opening the game as it will make your run invalid.)
- After the credits, re-enter Octo Canyon and scroll through all 5 Sectors in the "Records" tab to verify that all the collectables were obtained.

**Main Rules:**

- Complete all levels with every weapon on a new file.
- Collect all Scrolls and Sardinium.

**Timing:**

- Time starts when when your inkling pops out of the grate after entering Octo Canyon.
- Time ends when you touch the zapfish in the final level played. (when the screen around the zapfish starts to turn blurry)

**Break Rules:**

- You are allowed to take 3 breaks up to 15 minutes each. 
- For every 6 hours that passes; you gain 3 extra breaks.
- For every 12 hours speedran; you are allowed to stop the recording and take a sleep break.
- You have to exit to the home menu to start your break.
- You are not allowed to re-open the game during the break.
- Breaks must be timestamped in the run description.

**Video:**

- The version number must be visible and legible.
- Skipping the credits by quitting and re-opening the game is allowed.
- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio.
- All runs in this category require full video proof.
- After the run, scroll through all 5 Sectors in the "Records" tab to verify that all the collectables were obtained. As well as every weapon was used to complete every level.
- Getting the tickets and upgrading every weapon to max level is **not** required for 1000%.

categories.name: NG+ Octavioless
categories.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Complete all levels (excluding Octavio) on a completed file.

**Timing:**

- Time starts when when your inkling pops out of the grate after entering Octo Canyon.
- Time ends when you touch the Zapfish in the final level played. (when the screen around the Zapfish starts to turn blurry)

**Video:**

- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio
- All runs faster than 1:07:00 must have permanent video proof present.
- Speedruns without video proof must submit their splits with a picture in the description, or with a splits.io link.
- If you defeated Octavio during the run, the moderators will retime the run for you.
